title: Vue Workspace (List) View
description: Generates a staff-facing, paginated list view (WorkspaceTable + a debounced search filter bar) into an existing vue-app project.

project.description: The vue-app project to add the view to.
project.x-prompt: Which project should the workspace view be added to?

name.x-prompt: What should the view be called?

resource.description: API resource path segment -- the view fetches /api/v1/<resource>?page=&limit=&search=&sortBy=&sortDir=.

route.description: Route path added to router/index.ts, e.g. /applications.

columns.description: JSON array of table columns, in display order -- e.g. '[{"key":"status","label":"Status","type":"badge","sortable":true}]'. Each item: { key, label, type?: "text"|"date"|"currency"|"badge" (default "text"), sortable?: boolean, options?: [{value,label}], badgeMap?: {value: badgeType} }. Supply `options` for any column whose stored value is a code, or the table renders the raw code. Supply `badgeMap` on a `badge` column to give each status its colour (e.g. {"approved":"success","declined":"emergency"}); unmapped values render neutral. A plain array is also accepted when this generator is invoked programmatically. Nx's CLI option coercion only supports comma-separated primitive lists for array-typed schema properties, not JSON -- a JSON string is the only CLI syntax that actually survives Nx's own arg parsing for a structured list like this.

filters.description: JSON array of filter controls rendered above the table by FilterBar, beyond the --filterable search box -- e.g. '[{"key":"status","label":"Status","type":"dropdown","options":[{"value":"open","label":"Open"}]},{"key":"from","label":"From","type":"date"}]'. Each item: { key, label, type: "dropdown"|"date", options?: [{value,label}], anyLabel? }. Values are sent as query parameters alongside search/page/sort, so the API decides what each key means. Omit for no filter bar. Same JSON-string-on-the-CLI reasoning as --columns.

detailRoute.description: If set, each row gets a "View" action linking to `${detailRoute}/${row.id}` -- typically a vue-detail-view's route with the :id segment dropped. Omit to leave the actions column for manual customization.

heading.description: Page heading. Defaults to the view name, title-cased.

filterable.description: Whether to generate a debounced search input above the table.

icon.description: Ionicon name for the generated side-menu entry, e.g. `list`. goa-work-side-menu-item renders a blank item without one.

requiresAuth.description: Whether the generated route requires authentication.
